text:
twitter needs more accounts like blueprint...really good attitude, humble, helpful, and incredibly self-effacing.

I just have to highlight what he said here bc its 100% accurate:

"differentiated himself by working 6 days a week with DCFs"

thats really all there is to it...I've never met someone from a top-performing team or firm (esp MM) that had a different answer.

-work 24/6 (ex-SAC thing that sundays are ~mandatory) 
-dcf focus and/or some ROIIC framework
-and then the 3rd sentence I'd add... "everything goes in my model." everything. heard that same phrase over and over

behind every curtain of "greatness" is just flawless execution, blocking, tackling, discipline...there is no magic bullet.

"sweat the small details until you have a puddle of perfection."
